Hero.title: Dr. Meryem Youssoufi

About.title: The Organic Intellectual
About.paragraph1: Dr. Meryem YOUSSOUFI is a distinguished Professor of Sociology and Anthropology at University Ibn Zohr. Her academic career is defined by a deep commitment to understanding the complexities of human society, particularly in the context of mobility, migration, citizenship, and social and societal dynamics…
About.paragraph2: She believes in the power of research not only as an academic or intellectual exercise, but as a tool for the concrete transformation of societies. Her work bridges the gap between theoretical frameworks and practical applications, making significant contributions to both the university community and civil society.
About.philosophy_quote: True scholarship lies in the ability to connect abstract theory with the lived experiences of individuals, fostering understanding and driving positive social change.

Research.title: Academic Research & Projects
Research.subtitle: Exploring the frontiers of anthropology and sociology through rigorous, multidisciplinary and collaborative scientific research.
Research.citer_full_title: Europe and the Borders of Citizenship
Research.citer_description: Dr. Youssoufi is the lead coordinator, at the Faculty of Letters and Human Sciences (FLSH) of Agadir, of this international research initiative. Bridging University Ibn Zohr and the Catholic University of the West (UCO) in France, the project critically examines the evolving definitions of citizenship, identity building, and minority rights in a globalized world.
Research.dynamiques_note: A collective volume of eleven articles, in Arabic and French, organised around four themes: resource valorisation and development issues; socio-spatial change in the context of climate change; urban planning and territorial governance; migration and integration.
Research.mobil_description: A research project of the Catholic University of the West (UCO, Angers) devoted to mobilities, migrations and the mobilisations connected to them. Dr. Youssoufi, of University Ibn Zohr, is among the speakers giving the conclusions of the project’s second study day, “Migrations, mobilisations and ethics” (UCO Angers, 26 June 2024).

Leadership.title: Chess Leadership
Leadership.role_title: President of the Souss-Massa Regional Chess League
Leadership.role_description: Making history as the first woman in Morocco to hold this prestigious position, Dr. Youssoufi brings a visionary approach to sports leadership. She combines strategic thinking with a passion for community development.
Leadership.achievement_description: Under her guidance, the 'Najah Souss' club secured the 2024-2025 Throne Cup, marking a significant milestone in regional sports excellence.
Leadership.vision_quote: Chess is more than a game; it is a universal language that bridges cultural divides and fosters intellectual growth.
Leadership.vision_point2: Fostering social inclusion across diverse communities
Leadership.vision_point3: Promoting gender equality in sports leadership
